Alger, 22 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 22, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Algerian government has assessed the progress of its roadmap for the modernization of payment methods. Meeting under the chairmanship of Sifi Ghrieb, the executive noted a marked increase in digital transactions over the first nine months of 2026.
Hausses des paiements électroniques et r: Surge in electronic payments and decline in cash usage
Le gouvernement algérien a fait le point: The Algerian government took stock, during a meeting chaired on Wednesday, November 18 by Prime Minister Sifi Ghrieb, of the progress made in the payment systems modernization strategy. Data recorded during the first nine months of the year 2026 highlight a marked progression in digital transactions, accompanied by a drop in cash withdrawals from automated teller machines.
Pendant cette période, les opérations de: During this period, online payment operations reached 391 billion dinars, reflecting a 63% increase. Amounts settled via electronic payment terminals totaled 133 billion dinars, a 48% rise, while mobile phone settlements totaled 56.4 billion dinars. In parallel, the volume of withdrawals at automated teller machines stood at 3,777 billion dinars, recording a 14% decrease.
La feuille de route gouvernementale s'ar: The governmental roadmap revolves around three major orientations: regulatory and security compliance, the development of digital solutions, and the sectoral generalization of payment tools. This program aims to strengthen financial inclusion, modernize public banking institutions, and reduce dependency on cash.

Outre les services financiers, la rencon: In addition to financial services, the meeting focused on the implementation of directives given by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune in the Council of Ministers. The executive examined the project to digitalize ministerial statistical data in order to provide real-time updated indicators necessary for steering economic policies.
